changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Bind PRS screen assets to a logical datasource alias so local dbt marts and federated-query warehouses can be switched in configuration.
changeSet.sql: WITH target_database AS ( SELECT id FROM analytics_database WHERE lower(name) = lower('DTS dbt模型库') ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 ), database_alias_update AS ( UPDATE analytics_database db SET details_json = ( SELECT ( base.details || jsonb_build_object( 'logicalSourceAliases', ( SELECT jsonb_agg(alias ORDER BY alias) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT alias FROM ( SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(base.details -> 'logicalSourceAliases') = 'array' THEN base.details -> 'logicalSourceAliases' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) AS alias UNION ALL SELECT 'prs.flowerbiz.federated' UNION ALL SELECT 'prs.flowerbiz.mart' ) source_aliases WHERE alias IS NOT NULL AND btrim(alias) <> '' ) deduped_aliases ) ) )::text FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(db.details_json, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS details ) base ), updated_at = ${now} WHERE db.id = (SELECT id FROM target_database) RETURNING id ), repaired_screens AS ( UPDATE analytics_screen SET components_json = regexp_replace( regexp_replace( regexp_replace( components_json, '"databaseId"\s*:\s*"\{[0-9]+\}"', '"databaseAlias":"prs.flowerbiz.federated"', 'g' ), '"databaseId"\s*:\s*"\{\{DATABASE_ID\}\}"', '"databaseAlias":"prs.flowerbiz.federated"', 'g' ), '"databaseId"\s*:\s*[0-9]+', '"databaseAlias":"prs.flowerbiz.federated"', 'g' ), updated_at = ${now} WHERE id BETWEEN 290001 AND 290012 AND archived = false AND components_json IS NOT NULL RETURNING id ), repaired_versions AS ( UPDATE analytics_screen_version SET components_json = regexp_replace( regexp_replace( regexp_replace( components_json, '"databaseId"\s*:\s*"\{[0-9]+\}"', '"databaseAlias":"prs.flowerbiz.federated"', 'g' ), '"databaseId"\s*:\s*"\{\{DATABASE_ID\}\}"', '"databaseAlias":"prs.flowerbiz.federated"', 'g' ), '"databaseId"\s*:\s*[0-9]+', '"databaseAlias":"prs.flowerbiz.federated"', 'g' ) WHERE screen_id BETWEEN 290001 AND 290012 AND components_json IS NOT NULL RETURNING id ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM database_alias_update) AS database_alias_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repaired_screens) AS repaired_screen_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repaired_versions) AS repaired_version_count;
